526:t_1:89.en:
$$レド$$
「Training or not, you could get yourselves killed if you're careless.」

526:t_1:90.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「...say the two who gave up two hours in.」

526:t_1:91.en:
$$レド$$
「You refused to take part from the very start, didn't you?」

526:t_1:92.en:
$$アルト$$
「It's crazy to go along with something like that in the first place!」

526:t_1:93.en:
$$ルカ$$
「At this rate, it looks like we'll be buried in training until every unit's refit is done.」

526:t_1:94.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Still, Major $$カリーニン$$ impresses me. Splitting up the supplies and hiding them on a remote island in the Pacific, just in case.」

526:t_1:95.en:
$$カレン$$
「Yeah. $$テッサ$$ said losing that Major was a huge blow, both to our strength and to morale.」

526:t_1:96.en:
$$レド$$
「A refit of the units... Will $$宗介$$ and the others' units be made stronger?」

526:t_1:97.en:
$$ルカ$$
「$$ゼロ$$'s KMFs, and the ASs of $$マオ$$, $$クルツ$$ and $$クルーゾー$$.」

526:t_1:98.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「I get using the materials here to power up the ASs, but can they do something about the KMFs too?」

526:t_1:99.en:
$$ルカ$$
「According to Captain $$テスタロッサ$$, during the $$時獄戦役$$ $$ラクシャータ$$ and the others cooperated with $$ミスリル$$ as well.」

526:t_1:100.en:
$$ルカ$$
「An upgrade plan for $c's KMF was prepared back then too, so Captain $$テスタロッサ$$ herself is personally leading the refit.」

526:t_1:101.en:
$$カレン$$
(Thank you, $$テッサ$$... You remembered our promise from the $$時獄戦役$$.)

526:t_1:102.en:
$$アルト$$
「Will $$マオ$$ and the others' ASs be fitted with a $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$?」

526:t_1:103.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Unfortunately, that's impossible. The only $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ $$ミスリル$$ ever put to practical use was the one installed in the $$アーバレスト$$.」

526:t_1:104.en:
$$レド$$
「So the $$アーバレスト$$ now has neither a $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ nor Al. It's practically a hollow shell.」

526:t_1:106.en:
$$カレン$$
「If we keep chasing $$アマルガム$$... $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$, we're sure to meet $$かなめ$$ too...」

526:t_1:107.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$宗介$$ must be retraining himself because he believes that.」

526:t_1:109.en:
$$宗介$$
「You don't have to join me, $n. This isn't official training. It's personal.」

526:t_1:110.en:
$n
「Is it that you don't want me to see how wrecked you look?」

526:t_1:111.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Come on, come on, $n and $$宗介$$ too! If you keep chatting, Demon $$クルーゾー$$ is gonna come for you!」

526:t_1:112.en:
$n
「Ha ha... Looks like we're pretty badly cornered...」

526:t_1:113.en:
$$宗介$$
「I suppose so... That we can laugh at such a lame joke.」

526:t_1:114.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「That's because your muscles and nerves are rejoicing.」

526:t_1:115.en:
$$ティティ$$
「What's that supposed to mean?」

526:t_1:116.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「As the body is trained, the spirit is trained. As the spirit is trained, the body answers it. Through that repetition, a warrior grows strong.」

526:t_1:118.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「$l... I hear your father served in the Black Berets...」

526:t_1:119.en:
$n
「Yes... When the blood rushed to his head, he'd keep spewing the vulgar four-letter F-word his commanding officer always used.」

526:t_1:122.en:
$n
「Dad says that back in the army, at a field training camp, his instructor at the time drilled that spirit into him.」

526:t_1:123.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Perhaps your father also said something like this?」

526:t_1:124.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「War isn't so easy that you can win just by sweating in the mud...」

526:t_1:125.en:
$n
「But what can a man who's never been covered in sweat, mud, blood and tears possibly do... right?」

526:t_1:127.en:
$$宗介$$
「Don't tell me $n's father's instructor was 《$$あの中佐$$》...」

526:t_1:129.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「In that case, I'll train you strictly according to the Lieutenant Colonel's theory!」

526:t_1:132.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Run, run, run! Do you think that heavy ass of yours is a blonde who loves chasing men!」

526:t_1:134.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Is your drive nothing but talk! Are you swindlers who are only good at lip service!」

526:t_1:136.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Then put some spirit into it! Move, move, move your damn ass!!」

526:t_1:138.en:
$n
(Let's hang in there, $$宗介$$...! To rescue $$千鳥$$ too...!)

526:t_2:3.en:
$$レナード$$
「...You should enjoy it too. The moment that boring machine is engulfed in flames.」

526:t_2:6.en:
$$かなめ$$
「There was a guy in the next class over who was always staring at the girls in a slimy, lecherous way. Apparently he did stalker-like things too.」

526:t_2:7.en:
$$かなめ$$
「That creepy guy and you... If I had to go out with one of you, which one do you think I'd pick?」

526:t_2:9.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I'm asking you. Which do you think?」

526:t_2:12.en:
$$レナード$$
「Spare me the vulgar comparisons, and my...」

526:t_2:13.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I'm not going to do what you say. You're going to listen to the conclusion I came to.」

526:t_2:15.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Prepare to be amazed. I seriously spent a whole day thinking about this question, but...」

526:t_2:16.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I really can't tell. When it comes down to it, the only difference between you and that creepy guy is whether you're handsome or ugly.」

526:t_2:17.en:
$$レナード$$
「Please, enough. I'm not exactly free either.」

526:t_2:18.en:
$$かなめ$$
「That's it. That smug smile plastered on your face.」

526:t_2:19.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Locking me in a birdcage, treating me like a doll, taking everything from me, breaking me mentally, and smiling at the sight of me like that...」

526:t_2:20.en:
$$かなめ$$
「That smile is just as creepy as that creepy guy.」

526:t_2:22.en:
$$かなめ$$
「When $$宗介$$ first showed up in front of me, he was a pretty creepy guy...」

526:t_2:23.en:
$$かなめ$$
「But he was different from you. He never grinned like an idiot...」

526:t_2:24.en:
$$かなめ$$
「No matter what happened, he fought with straight eyes.」

526:t_2:26.en:
$$レナード$$
「I'm always serious too, as I told you in Tokyo.」

526:t_2:27.en:
$$かなめ$$
「You mean that time on the rooftop in the rain? That didn't explain anything.」

526:t_2:28.en:
$$かなめ$$
「When it comes down to it, I bet you don't really understand what it means to love someone yourself. With an attitude like that, even $$テッサ$$ turned her back on you.」

526:t_2:30.en:
$$かなめ$$
「You're sarcastic and all about appearances, and you've never opened your heart to anyone. You see women as nothing but objects.」

526:t_2:31.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Could it be that common thing? A lack of parental love?」
